findings.title: Authority-bound reference approval can be fabricated to launder a newer package
findings.reproduction: In a real-Git fixture, mutate the newer reference package and APPROVAL.yaml while retaining an unresolvable prior W1.A05 authority pointer; approval_lineage_errors returns no errors.
findings.requiredResolution: Resolve and authenticate the exact authority-record introduction commit, blob hash, amendment/change-request identities, approval status, ancestry, and uniqueness relative to the preceding reference approval. Add actual-authority and fabricated-reapproval regressions.

findings.title: The maintenance control-only invariant excludes product build and non-UI runtime paths
findings.reproduction: In a real-Git fixture, add a throwing apps/desktop/scripts/assemble-application.mjs to an otherwise exact reviewed maintenance sequence; ui_change_gate.validate returns ok=true.
findings.requiredResolution: Enforce an explicit control-only maintenance envelope across product, build, and runtime paths; restore the assembly scripts to predecessor semantics for maintenance and move their v1.4 activation into T04-authorized work. Add build-script and non-UI-runtime denial regressions.
